name: fde-operator
description: Search an FDE knowledge graph, register interview evidence, and export workflow playbooks. Proposes only; approvals stay in the review console.
long_description:
Exposes the FDE Agent Platform's 23 MCP tools to Claude Desktop over stdio.

The server runs as the Postgres role `fde_agent`: it can read the graph, register evidence, and write proposals, and it holds no privilege to write `kg.*` or to decide a gate. Approvals and merges happen in the review console under the reviewer's own JWT — that boundary is enforced by database grants, not by prompting.

Prerequisites, both provisioned by whoever runs the platform: a checkout of the repository, and `uv` (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on PATH. The bundle launches the server from that checkout so it runs the exact code the project's CI tests.

db_dsn.title: Database DSN
db_dsn.description: Postgres DSN for the fde_agent role, with the db/ migrations applied. Provisioned by whoever runs the platform, e.g. postgresql://fde_agent@host:5432/fde

repo_dir.title: Platform checkout
repo_dir.description: Directory containing the FDE Agent Platform repository. The server is launched from here with uv, so it runs the same code as CI.

tools.name: kg_head_commit
tools.description: The engagement's latest sealed commit — call first; everything else reads as of it.

tools.name: kg_as_of
tools.description: Read the graph as it stood at a past timestamp.

tools.name: kg_search
tools.description: Hybrid semantic + lexical search over nodes and anchored evidence chunks.

tools.name: kg_lexical_search
tools.description: Exact-name search for a term you can quote.

tools.name: kg_get_node
tools.description: One node with its attributes and evidence.

tools.name: kg_traverse
tools.description: Walk typed edges out from a node.

tools.name: kg_dependency_closure
tools.description: Everything a node transitively depends on.

tools.name: kg_impact_radius
tools.description: Everything transitively affected by a node.

tools.name: kg_process_flow
tools.description: A process walked end to end, in order.

tools.name: kg_propose
tools.description: Draft a proposal — never writes the graph.

tools.name: kg_submit_proposal
tools.description: Submit a proposal, freezing the gate set a human must clear.

tools.name: kg_proposal_status
tools.description: A proposal's status and its outstanding gates.

tools.name: drift_list
tools.description: Open drift signals for an engagement.

tools.name: drift_scan
tools.description: Re-run drift detection against the system of record.

tools.name: drift_triage
tools.description: Record a triage decision on a drift signal.

tools.name: wf_list
tools.description: Workflows for an engagement.

tools.name: wf_get
tools.description: One workflow and its ordered steps.

tools.name: wf_draft
tools.description: Author a draft workflow — never publishes.

tools.name: wf_export_playbook
tools.description: Export a workflow as one Markdown document a person can follow.

tools.name: kg_register_source
tools.description: Register a piece of evidence so its text can be ingested and cited.

tools.name: kg_ingest_chunks
tools.description: Attach evidence text to a source, anchored to the nodes it supports.

tools.name: kg_list_sources
tools.description: Registered evidence sources, with chunk and embedding counts.

tools.name: hitl_export_dashboard
tools.description: How decisions are flowing, as one document — live counts, not a pinned artefact.
